long_biography.plain_text:
Diane Hendricks began in real estate, selling custom homes and establishing a property business before she and roofing contractor Ken Hendricks acquired three struggling supply centres. Drawing on their established property operations and Ken's contracting experience, they co-founded ABC Supply in 1982 around a simple premise: professional contractors deserved better service and respect.

After Ken's death, Hendricks remained owner and chair through the housing downturn rather than sell the business. She led the purchases of Bradco Supply and L&W Supply, expanding the company's geographic reach and product range while preserving family control. Alongside ABC Supply, she has continued commercial-property investment and development focused on Beloit's industrial and downtown renewal.
